column2: Test the generator with known-good accessories before blaming it
Inspect every reusable accessory along its full length under good light
Check each footswitch pedal for correct mode and immediate release
Confirm single-use items are not reprocessed and pads are within expiry
Follow the manufacturer's PM interval or the local rule, whichever is stricter
Record generator software version, analyser identity, every value and limit, and removed items
